sourceContract.distinct: Frame-local CanvasPattern/Path2D tile pass; no cross-frame output, source-content or CanvasPattern cache
sourceContract.bounded: Original visible grid plus original margin; maximum4096cells otherwise original fallback
sourceContract.eligibility: 16x16 native canvas cells; integer camera and transform, original source-over/full alpha/no effects; no reed overhang, WRD dips or edge lips
sourceContract.mutation: Patterns rebuilt from actual source every call; no reference/dimension cache that can miss in-place repaint
sourceContract.ownership: No new canvas backing stores, no retained sources/patterns/path across calls; original current path and fill style preserved
sourceContract.fallback: Entire original byte-preserved tile loop remains for all unsupported sources/state, no partial paint before eligibility completes

qualification: Original tile loop has up to visible-grid native image calls and prior source/alias review blocked cached output without content revisions. This distinct no-cache approach avoids that blocker. Actual eligible coverage, native equivalence and useful timing remain unproved; parent drawWorld samples are upper bounds including other work.
